name: Wappend
author: armandfederico

sections.description:
Wappend adds a configurable floating WhatsApp chat button — a click-to-chat contact widget for customer support and sales — with privacy-friendly aggregate click statistics and automatic analytics events.

Features:

  • Large ON/OFF switch.
  • Live desktop and smartphone previews.
  • Four screen positions and three button sizes.
  • Desktop, smartphone, or combined visibility.
  • Three predefined distances from the screen edges.
  • Optional pre-filled WhatsApp message.
  • Optional text label with width, device, and hover controls.
  • Configurable display delay, minimum scroll, and z-index.
  • Aggregate click totals for all time, 7 days, and 30 days.
  • Automatic wappend_click events for gtag or dataLayer when available.
  • Translation-ready POT catalog for WordPress.org language packs.
  • A compact informational reference to the separate Wappend Pro add-on.
  • A dedicated Pro comparison page inside the plugin settings.
sections.installation:
1. Copy the “wappend” folder into “wp-content/plugins”.
  2. Activate Wappend from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Settings > Wappend.
  4. Configure the phone number, message, position, size, and visibility.
sections.faq:
Do I need a WhatsApp Business account?

No. Wappend works with both a personal WhatsApp number and a WhatsApp Business number. Enter the number in international format (for example +393331234567) under Settings > Wappend and turn the switch on.

What happens when a visitor clicks the button?

The visitor is taken to WhatsApp (the app on mobile, or web.whatsapp.com/WhatsApp Desktop on a computer) with a chat already open to your number, optionally with the pre-filled message you configured.

Can I use a different WhatsApp number for different pages, departments, or operators?

Not in Wappend Free, which uses a single WhatsApp number across the whole site. Assigning multiple numbers or departments to specific pages is available in Wappend Pro.

Can I hide the button on specific pages or show it only during business hours?

Wappend Free does not include page exclusions or time-based scheduling; the button follows the same position, delay, and visibility rules everywhere it is enabled. Custom schedules and URL exclusions are available in Wappend Pro.

Does Wappend track my visitors?

No. Wappend only stores an aggregate daily click count (total, last 7 days, last 30 days); it never stores IP addresses, visitor identities, phone numbers, or message contents. If gtag or dataLayer are already present on your site, Wappend also emits a “wappend_click” event for your existing Google Analytics or Google Tag Manager setup, without installing any tracking script of its own.

screenshots.caption: General tab: WhatsApp number, pre-filled message, position, size, distance from the edges, visibility, and z-index, with the live desktop and smartphone preview on the right.
Label tab: enable an optional text label next to the button and control its text, width, visibility, and whether it is always visible or shown on hover/focus.
Analytics tab: aggregate click statistics (total, last 7 days, last 30 days), the Google Analytics/Tag Manager event details, and the statistics reset action.

Pro tab: overview of the advanced features available in the separate Wappend Pro add-on (multiple accounts, custom schedules, WooCommerce integration, custom colors, detailed statistics, and URL exclusions).
